description: This file defines the LDAPUserLookupSetting class, which encapsulates LDAP search configuration settings such as base DN, search scope, and attribute mappings for user lookup in an LDAP directory within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPUserLookupSetting
classes.description: A class representing LDAP user lookup configuration, including attributes for search scope, user attributes, search filter, and employee selector mapping, with methods for configuration and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LDAPUserLookupSetting with a specified base distinguished name (DN) and default employee selector mapping.

methods.name: getBaseDN
methods.description: Returns the base distinguished name (DN) used for LDAP searches.

methods.name: getSearchScope
methods.description: Returns the search scope used in LDAP searches (subtree or one level).

methods.name: setSearchScope
methods.description: Sets the search scope for LDAP queries, validating against allowed values.

methods.name: getUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute used to identify the username.

methods.name: setUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute to be used as the username key.

methods.name: getUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute used for a unique user ID, nullable.

methods.name: setUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute for the user's unique identifier.

methods.name: getUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Returns the LDAP search filter used when looking up users.

methods.name: setUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search filter expression.

methods.name: getEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Returns the LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping instance associated with this setting.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the configuration settings into an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an LDAPUserLookupSetting instance from an associative array.
